title: Status properties/DisableOverhead
html:
See also Status properties.

DisableOverhead is a status property.

List of conditions with DisableOverhead

More...
Condition Effects
Ability Drain: Charisma
  • Charisma reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Dexterity
  • Dexterity reduced by  Ability Drain
Ability Drain: Intelligence
  • Intelligence reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Strength
  • Strength reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ability Drain: Wisdom
  • Wisdom reduced by  Ability Drain.
Ambushing
  • Affected entity will attack as soon as its enemies are within reach. It can only be spotted with a successful Perception Check.
Ansur's Ire
  • A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open.
Arcane Ammunition
  • Ranged weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Force.
Astrally Projected
  • While your body resides in the cold expanses of the Astral Sea, you have projected a likeness of yourself here for the evening.
Aura of Courage
  • Can't be  Frightened within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Devotion
  • Can't be  Charmed within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Aura of Hate
  • Gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Murder
  • Affected entity is Vulnerable to ⁠Piercing damage.
Aura of Possibility
  • While near the God of Ambition, this creature has a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Possibility
  • Any allies near Gale Dekarios, the God of Ambition, receive a +10 bonus to all Ability Checks.
Aura of Protection
  • Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
Aura of Warding
  • Resistant to damage from spells within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Bound
  • This relic is bound to its current owner by a powerful aura.
  • Bound items cannot be removed from your inventory.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • Can be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet.
  • Immune from if Wet.
  •  Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.
Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
Burning Fiercely
  • Takes 1d10⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Chilled
  • Affected entity is vulnerable to ⁠Cold damage and resistant to ⁠Fire damage.
  • Applying  Wet to a chilled entity will make it Frozen for Duration: 1 turn.
Clear Area
  • Hiding in an unobscured area. Will be caught on sight.
Clinging Shadows
  • While remaining obscured, affected entity has  Advantage on  Saving Throws.
Covert Critical
  • As long as the affected entity remains obscured, the number it needs to  Attack Roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
Darkveil Precision
  • As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has a +1d4 bonus to ranged  Attack Rolls.
Difficult Terrain
  • Movement Speed halved
Difficult Terrain: Deep Water
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Lava
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Mud
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Vines
  • Movement speed halved.
Difficult Terrain: Web
  • Movement speed halved.
Displace
  • Creatures suffering Falling damage as a result of your actions take an additional 1d8⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Displaced
  • Until you take damage, foes have  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls against you.
Downed
  • If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws. On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you  die.
  • Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure.
  • If you regain any Hit Points, the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point.
Drenched
  • Your melee attacks inflict  Wet on the target.
Duergar Poison
  • A rare poison has sickened the victim.
  • Cannot perform any Actions or Reactions.
  • Automatically fails any Saving Throws.
  • All attacks against the target have  Advantage and Critical Hit if within 3 m (10 ft).
  • Immune to  Prone
Ever Radiant
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Radiant.
Exploding Flumph
  • This spirit will explode at the end of the turn. Each creature within 2 m (7 ft) must succeed a Dexterity  Saving Throw or take 1d6⁠⁠Force.
Fiendish Obeisance: Kneel
  • Affected entity has been compelled to kneel by a fiend. It cannot move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against it have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the entity. The entity must spend half its movement speed to stand up.
Flaming Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the sphere at end of their turn take 2d6⁠⁠Fire damage. On a successful save, it still takes half damage.
Formless Slaughter
  • This creature has a +1 bonus to Attack and Damage rolls while disguised or shapeshifted.
Galvanic Currents
  • Blue lightning flits across the weapon's surface. Deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Lightning.
God of Ambition
  • Mere mortals whisper petitions to the newly divine Gale Dekarios as The Once-Wizard, High Aspirant, The Lord of Zeal - but none have yet been granted an audience with the God of Ambition. Until tonight, that is.
Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack
  • Can make a melee attack as a  Bonus Action.
Greater Toughness
  • This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it.
Hag's Trickery
  • Is this Ethel - or an illusion?
Heartform Mapped
  • The affected entity's  Violent,  Craven,  Jealous,  Melancholy, Prying,  False, or  Wayward Heart has been mapped and punished by Viconia.
Heat
  • Engulfed by a vengeful fire. Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage each turn, but can use  Heat Convergence.
  • Heat Convergence consumes all remaining turns of Heat to deal extra ⁠Fire damage on their next fire spell or attack.
  • Heat has a maximum Duration: 7 turns.
Heavily Obscured
  • Hiding in a Heavily Obscured area. Will go undetected unless they get too close to another creature.
Hellish Sphere
  • Enemies and objects within 3 m (10 ft) of the sphere at the end of their turn take 6d6⁠⁠Fire. On a successful save, they still take half damage.
Heroism
  • Can't be  Frightened.
  • Receive  5 temporary hit points per turn.
Hiding
  • Affected entity is invisible to enemies until it crosses their cone of sight.
  • The entity has  Advantage on all  Attack Rolls.
Holy Fire
  • Takes 1~4⁠⁠Radiant damage per turn.
Idyllic Aura
  • Grants Silvanus' Blessing to creatures within range.
Inevitable Resolve
  • Any effect controlling or incapacitating this creature will cease at the end of its next turn.
Infernal Burning
  • Takes 1d4⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
  • CANNOT be removed with the  Help action, using a Healing Type Potion or gaining  Wet.
  • The entity affected cannot regain Hit Points
Ironwood Harmony
  • Deals an additional 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning while imbued with the druidic magic of  Shillelagh.
Lethal Concealment
  • Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic while  Hidden.
Lightly Obscured
  • Hiding in a Lightly Obscured area. Has to make a Stealth check when caught.
Mark of the Shifter
  • While shapeshifting or disguising itself, the affected entity gains a +1d4 bonus to all  Ability Checks.
Marshalled Undead
  • The affected entity has  Advantage against being  Turned while within 18 m (60 ft) of the spellcaster.
Martial Exertion
  • Affected entity has pushed past its physical limits, taking 6d6⁠⁠Piercing damage per turn to perform an additional attack per turn and to double its movement speed.
Medium Toughness
  • This material is unusually strong. Only a hit that deals at least 22 damage can damage it.
Miasmic Mists
  • Possibly  Blind targets within 4 m (13 ft) and deal 3d6⁠⁠Necrotic at the start of Cazador's turns.
Mobile Flourish
  • Can teleport to the target hit with  Mobile Flourish.
Moonbeam
  • Ghostly flames engulf any creature that enters this silvery light or starts its turn inside the light. They deal 2d10⁠⁠Radiant. On a successful save, targets still take half damage.
Moonfire
  • The blessing of Dame Aylin's divine mother deals 2d10⁠⁠Radiant to foes that come within 3 m (10 ft) of her or start their turn there.
Moonshield
  • Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern. The  Shadow Curse does not affect this entity.
Morninglord's Bulwark
  • Lathander's warding light protects this door from any harm dealing less than 50 damage.
Nightbringer's Beloved
  • Shar's ardent favour lets her chosen disciple regain 7d8⁠⁠Hit Points every time they use their Channel Divinity Charges.
Non-Lethal Damage
  • Non-lethal damage does not kill creatures if it reduces their hit points to 0, it just leaves them unconscious.
Oil of Combustion
  • If the affected entity takes ⁠Fire damage, it deals 3d6⁠⁠Fire in a 3 m (10 ft) radius.
Orphic Favour
  • While within 18 m (60 ft) of Prince Orpheus, the affected entity has resistance to ⁠Psychic and a +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
Paid the Price
  • You have a +1 bonus to Intimidation checks, but  Disadvantage on Perception checks. Additionally, you have  Disadvantage when attacking Hags.
Parried
  • Already  Parried this turn and has to recover before Parrying again.
Phantasmal Force

Haunted by an echo of the last thing that attacked them.

  • Takes 1d6⁠⁠Psychic damage each turn.
  • When the target takes damage from another source, Phantasmal Force changes to that damage type.
  • At the end of each turn, the target makes an  Intelligence Saving Throw. On a success, the condition ends.
Pinned
  • Pinned under a beam.
Pixie Blessing
  • The Shadow Curse cannot affect this creature thanks to a pixie's protective magic.
Plant Growth
  • The ground is covered with plants and weeds. Movement Speed is quartered.
Projected Image
  • This magical projection cannot be targeted or attacked.
Prone
  • Can't move or take  Actions,  Bonus Actions, or  Reactions, and has  Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity  Saving Throws.
  • Attacks against a Prone creature have  Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
  • A Prone creature must spend half its  Movement Speed to stand up.
  • Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
  • If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.
Prowling
  • Stalking its prey. While  Invisible, the affected entity's next attack deals additional 1d8 damage.
Psionic Visages
  • Affected entity is immune to ⁠Bludgeoning, ⁠Piercing, and ⁠Slashing damage while a Psionic Visage stands.
  • When the caster is struck, a visage will shatter, striking the attacker directly with 2d6⁠⁠Psychic damage.
Psionic Ward
  • Affected entity has a +5 bonus to  Saving Throws and can't be  Frightened while within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.
Rapport Spores
  • Affected creatures can communicate telepathically with one another. Does not have a mechanical effect.
Recast Speak with Dead
  • Can recast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot.
Revitalising Gore
  • Affected entity is drenched in its enemies' blood. It regains 2d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
  • At level 10, the healing is increased to 4d6⁠⁠Hit Points per turn.
Roiling Hellfire
  • Flames from the heart of Avernus engulf this entity, inflicting 6d6⁠⁠Fire damage per turn.
Sacred Munitions
  • Affected entity's ranged weapon attacks possibly inflict  Turn Undead on a target.
Shadespell
  • As long as it remains obscured, the affected entity has +1 to spell save DC.
Shadow-Cursed Undead
  • Those who die in the shadows are cursed to remain there forever.
  • These undead have reduced Hit Points and Strength, are Resistant to ⁠Necrotic damage and cannot use Spells or Weapon Actions.
Shapechanged
  • This creature has shapechanged into a male human.
Sharran Retribution
  •  Shield of Faith reduces all damage by 2 and deals 1d4⁠⁠Necrotic damage back at the attacker.
Shield of Faith
  • Receives +2 bonus to  Armour Class.
Silvanus' Blessing
  • Has Proficiency in Nature and Animal Handling
Skilled Skullduggery
  • While hidden, the number the affected entity needs to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack.
Sneaking
  • Hiding in an unobscured area. Will be caught on sight.
Soul Pillar Proximity
  • Raphael is surrounded by Soul Pillars, granting Raphael's attacks an additional 1d12⁠⁠Fire damage (per pillar) and a +3 bonus to his Dexterity score (per pillar).
Spectral Observer
  • Though you are too dangerous to mingle in person, Withers has allowed you to observe this gathering - but only observe.
